title: Deep Review Structural Plan
description: One plan for one structural initiative. PRODUCERS: Phase 7, which emits three independent variants per initiative (07-plans/<initiative>/{opus,sonnet,fable}.json), and Phase 9, which emits one synthesised plan per initiative (09-synthesis/<initiative>.json, variant='synthesis') built from the variants AND the Phase 8 refutations against them. CONSUMERS: Phase 8 (attacks a variant), Phase 9 (synthesises), Phase 10 (reads estimated_loc, dependencies_on_other_initiatives and the design's risk levels to rank). FILE SHAPE: a plan artifact is ONE bare plan object per file — like map.schema.json, not the collection envelope. Three variants means three files, not three items. Nothing here executes: Phases 0-10 end at a ranked table.

initiative_id.description: Joins to the key in 04-ledger.json `initiatives`, e.g. 'INIT-03-io-output-resilience'. All three variants and the synthesis carry the same value.

variant.description: Which of the three independent Phase 7 designs this is, or 'synthesis' for the Phase 9 output. DESIGN-IT-TWICE: the variants are authored by different models so diversity is real rather than three samples from one prior. The value names the DESIGN SLOT, not the runtime model — the model actually used is in provenance.

provenance.description: Who authored this plan. Stamped by the ORCHESTRATOR from the runtime pane footer, never self-reported — twux's EFFORT column records the launch flag, not the live tier.

summary.description: What this plan does and why this shape rather than another. The one paragraph a reviewer reads before the steps.

findings_addressed.description: The finding ids from 04-ledger.json this plan resolves. A plan that leaves an initiative's findings unaddressed is incomplete; a plan addressing findings outside its initiative is scope creep.

design.description: The ordered steps. Each is independently reviewable and independently verifiable — a step whose verification is 'the suite passes' is not a step, it is a hope.

intent.description: What changes and why — in deep-module terms: which interface shrinks, which behaviour moves behind it.

files.description: Repo-relative paths this step touches. This is the scope fence an implementer would be handed.

risk.description: low = mechanical, file-local, behaviour-preserving by construction. medium = crosses a module boundary or changes a call graph. high = touches the render loop, packages/core, or a live output path.

verification.description: The specific evidence that this step is correct — a named test, a command, a measurable. Non-model evidence outranks a reading.

reverses.description: How to undo just this step, when it differs from the plan-level rollback_strategy.

sequencing.description: Execution waves: each element is an array of step ids that may run CONCURRENTLY, and waves run in order. Steps sharing a mutation seam belong in different waves whatever the schedule pressure. Every id in `design` must appear exactly once across all waves.

interface_deltas.description: The objective function made explicit: less interface per unit of behaviour. One entry per module whose public surface changes. An empty array is legitimate (a purely internal plan, or a resilience initiative that adds code) but says the plan does not score on interface reduction.

at.description: The module or path whose public interface changes.

removed.description: Exported symbols this plan removes from that surface.

added.description: Exported symbols this plan adds. Relocating an interface is not reducing it.

net_interface_change.description: 'reduces' is the only value that scores under the objective function. Deliberate 'increases' is allowed — say why in `note`.

behaviour_parity_evidence_plan.description: How this plan would PROVE it changed no behaviour, measured against Phase 0's baseline rather than intuition. This is the counterweight to 'smaller is better': a plan that cannot show parity is a plan that cannot be safely approved.

checks.description: Each a runnable command or a named test/measurement. `pnpm gates`, never `pnpm test` — only gates takes the machine-wide lock.

known_gaps.description: Where a green suite would NOT prove parity — 0%-coverage regions, untested IO paths, timing-dependent render behaviour. Claiming 'none' is itself a claim and must be justified here.

baseline_reference.description: What the checks are compared against, e.g. the Phase 0 baseline test count and sha.

rollback_strategy.description: How the whole initiative is backed out after landing — revert boundaries, feature flags, data migrations that cannot be reversed. 'git revert' is only an answer when the plan is one commit.

estimated_loc.description: Estimated total lines changed (added + removed). Joins to ranked.schema.json estimated_loc. An estimate, not a measurement — it feeds ranking, not acceptance.

dependencies_on_other_initiatives.description: Initiative ids that must land BEFORE this one. Phase 10 turns these into the approval order; a cycle here is a planning defect, not a schedule.

open_questions.description: What this plan could not settle. Architecture-shaping reframes, product taste and domain-model calls are Trent's — surface them here rather than guessing.

blocks_execution.description: True if no step can start until this is answered.

owner.description: trent = product/taste/architecture call. synthesis = Phase 9 should resolve it from the other variants. implementer = decidable at build time.

synthesis_inputs.description: REQUIRED when variant is 'synthesis', forbidden in spirit otherwise. Phase 9 must build from what SURVIVED, not from what was proposed — so it names both the variants it read and the Phase 8 attacks it read against them.

variants_considered.description: Fewer than two and this is a copy, not a synthesis.

refutations_consumed.description: Paths to the 08-refutations artifacts read. A synthesis that ignored the attacks is the failure this field exists to catch.

rationale.description: What was taken from which variant, what was dropped, and which surviving attack forced each change.

attacks_addressed.description: The specific Phase 8 attack claims this plan answers.

allOf.description: ENFORCED: a synthesis must declare what it synthesised from. Otherwise 'synthesis' is indistinguishable from a fourth opinion.
ENFORCED: a high-risk step needs a rollback of its own. The plan-level strategy is too coarse for the steps that can take the render loop down.
